div.div:
Notes
*1 Measured S3 PutObject to FlexCache NFS read
p50 14 ms (aws CLI + cat, n=30); p50 8 ms with a persistent boto3 session. The gap is the measurement method
*2 FlexCache overhead
p50 +5 ms against a direct origin read
*3 SMB and NFS are equivalent
p50 7 ms each over persistent mounts (n=30)
*4 The cache is FSx for ONTAP or on-premises ONTAP 9
Those are the two FlexCache configurations AWS documents. Cloud Volumes ONTAP, ONTAP Select, Azure NetApp Files and Google Cloud NetApp Volumes are unverified, which is not the same as unsupported
